name: create_social_graphic
description: Design and render a social-media graphic (Instagram, X, LinkedIn, etc.) from supplied copy and an optional visual brief. Produces a PNG via HTML/CSS layout.

content.description: Exact text and facts to show (headline, body, CTA, handles). Do not invent copy.

designBrief.description: Optional visual direction (mood, colors, style). Does not add new factual content.

platform.description: Target preset: instagram_post, instagram_story, twitter_post, linkedin_post, facebook_cover, youtube_thumbnail, open_graph. Default instagram_post.

outputPath.description: Where to save the PNG under workspace/ (e.g. designs/launch-post.png).

imagePaths.description: Optional workspace-relative image paths (logos, photos) to include in the layout.

imageUrls.description: Optional HTTPS URLs to download before layout.
